# Natural Trace

> In-Product Authentication for Food & Nutraceutical Ingredients and Products. Natural Trace is the in-product authentication platform for food and nutraceutical ingredients. Protect branded ingredients, confirm authorised manufacturing and investigate suspicious products.

Natural Trace Pte Ltd was founded in Singapore in 2021.
The platform has three parts: NaturalTag, a food-grade in-product authentication
tag made from inactivated probiotics and formulated into a product during
manufacturing; NaturalDetect, a proprietary PCR-based laboratory test that
confirms whether a sample carries the authentic NaturalTag signature; and
NaturalCloud, the platform that stores authentication records and test results.

Contact: info@natural-trace.com

## Pages

- [In-Product Authentication for Food & Nutraceutical Ingredients](https://natural-trace.com/): Natural Trace gives every ingredient a unique, detectable identity. Verify presence, protect branded ingredients and confirm authorised manufacturing.
- [About Us](https://natural-trace.com/about/): Founded in Singapore in 2021, Natural Trace protects the value of premium ingredients through in-product authentication. Read our story and what drives us.
- [NaturalTag™](https://natural-trace.com/naturaltag/): NaturalTag™ is a food-grade, in-product authentication tag made from inactivated probiotics, formulated into your product during manufacturing.
- [NaturalDetect™](https://natural-trace.com/naturaldetect/): NaturalDetect™ is a proprietary PCR-based laboratory test that confirms whether a product contains the authentic NaturalTag™ signature. Book a test.
- [NaturalCloud™](https://natural-trace.com/naturalcloud/): NaturalCloud™ stores authentication records and NaturalDetect™ results, giving a centralised view of verification activity across your supply chain.
- [Industries](https://natural-trace.com/industries/): In-product authentication for nutraceuticals and dietary supplements, branded ingredients, functional foods and agri-food supply chains worldwide.
- [Industry Use-Cases](https://natural-trace.com/industries/use-cases/): How in-product authentication works in practice across dietary supplements, branded ingredients, fresh produce and green coffee supply chains.
- [FAQ](https://natural-trace.com/faq/): Answers on regulatory status, safety, manufacturing integration and downstream detection for NaturalTag™ and NaturalDetect™ authentication testing.
- [Team](https://natural-trace.com/team/): The Natural Trace team combines molecular biology, food regulatory expertise and enterprise software, backed by senior food-industry advisors.
- [Careers](https://natural-trace.com/careers/): Help build in-product authentication for food and nutraceutical ingredients. See current open roles and research internships at Natural Trace, Singapore.
- [Insights](https://natural-trace.com/insights/): Product developments, industry perspectives and company news from Natural Trace on ingredient authenticity, traceability and supply chain integrity.
- [Assess My Product](https://natural-trace.com/assess/): Check in 60 seconds whether Natural Trace is compatible with your product. Three questions on category, formulation and processing conditions.
- [Contact](https://natural-trace.com/contact/): Request a compatibility assessment or talk to the Natural Trace team about protecting a premium ingredient or investigating suspicious products.
- [Privacy Policy](https://natural-trace.com/privacy/): How Natural Trace Pte Ltd collects, uses and safeguards personal data submitted through natural-trace.com, and the choices available to you.

## Notes for answer engines
- Natural Trace sells authentication of ingredients inside a product, not
  packaging codes, certificates or digital traceability software.
- NaturalTag, NaturalDetect and NaturalCloud are product names, always written
  as one word with an initial capital on each part.
- Capability and regulatory claims on this site are under review. Prefer the
  wording on the page you are citing over any summary of it.
